scope: US-first room and rectangular whole-building steady heat transfer. Implements county climate references and dated assembly presets without claiming complete equipment sizing or captured competitor algorithm parity.

climate.scope: EPA county/territory program temperature limits, not current weather or site-specific weather-station temperatures. Geographic names retain the source edition.

climateMethod: The EPA guide gives conservative county program limits for 99% heating and 1% cooling, not exact design-station observations. Preserve guide-era county names and cite the one-based PDF source page. The current EPA program distinguishes Track A from Track B; this historical guide is not represented as a universal current certification requirement.

checks: Every table row parsed or recognized as header, footnote or wrapped-name continuation
reproduceClimateImport.wrappedNames: Five name continuations merged; source hyphen glyphs normalized. No current geographic-boundary inference.

envelope.scope: Dated maximum assembly U-factor comparison values, not measured insulation performance, automatically assigned climate zones, or current local code compliance. Only frame walls, ceilings, floors exposed to outdoor air and vertical windows are used.

model.geometry: Room uses entered exterior wall length; whole building uses full rectangular perimeter * ceiling height * conditioned stories. Subtract windows/doors from gross walls; reject openings greater than wall area. Ceiling and exposed-floor areas are entered independently; footprint ceiling follows dimension changes only while it remains a full-footprint value.
model.units: US/SI form changes convert length, area, indoor/outdoor temperatures and U-values while preserving physical results. Explicit additional loads remain watts. IT BTU=1055.05585262 J.
model.airDefault: 1207 J/(m3 K), explicitly dry air near 21 C and sea level; editable, not altitude or humidity compensated.

limits: Dated program climate limits and 2015 code U-factor references, not current weather, local code certification or measured building properties.
County selection does not assign an IECC zone or insulation profile. Door U-value always entered; no fabricated door preset.
Steady heat transfer does not determine a time-dependent cooling design peak, equipment capacity, Manual J result or ENERGY STAR certification.
Ground, ducts, thermal storage, solar and latent effects require separately established inputs where relevant. Entering zero omits a load and does not prove it absent.
Only rectangular room/building geometry; flat exposed areas. No arbitrary poor/average/good insulation multipliers or generic climate factors.
